# Jubilees Chapter 9 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 9:3 — Listing Japheth's sons

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras — seven portions" | Full literal with repeated "and" |
| LOGOS | "Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras — seven portions" | List with Oxford comma |
| PNEUMA | "Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras" (no count given separately) | List only; drops "seven portions" notation |

**SOPHIA:** Adopted LOGOS. The "seven portions" count is meaningful — it is the Jubilees structure echoing the seven-fold creation. PNEUMA's omission of the count loses this structural marker. EMET's repeated "and" is authentic Hebrew list style but unwieldy in English.

---

## 9:15 — "not a holy land" — theological note on Canaan's portion

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "it was not a holy land, and it was given to Shem's lot" | Full literal |
| LOGOS | "this was not a holy land and it had been given to Shem's lot" | Slight rephrasing |
| PNEUMA | "this land was not a holy land — it had been given to Shem's portion" | Same meaning, dash for effect |

**SOPHIA:** Adopted LOGOS. All three essentially agree. Minor stylistic difference between "given to Shem's lot" vs. "given to Shem's portion" — "lot" is the established Jubilees term for the division.

---

## 9:16 — "center of the earth" vs. "middle of the earth"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "Shem and his sons went towards the center of the earth" | "Center" |
| LOGOS | "Shem and his sons went toward the center of the earth" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "Shem's family took the middle of the earth" | "Middle" |

**SOPHIA:** Adopted LOGOS "center of the earth." "Center" is the established term in Jubilees' geography; cf. the concept of the navel of the earth (Jerusalem). "Middle" (PNEUMA) is equally accurate but "center" has stronger geographical resonance.

---

## 9:20 — "all the sons of God" — scope of the curse

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "against all the sons of God" | Literal Ge'ez |
| LOGOS | "against all the sons of God" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "any of the sons of God" | "Any" instead of "all" |

**SOPHIA:** Adopted LOGOS/EMET. "All the sons of God" is the full scope of the curse formula. PNEUMA's "any" narrows it.

---

## 9:21 — "Noah made them rejoice" — causative

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "Noah made them rejoice" | Literal causative |
| LOGOS | "Noah made them rejoice" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "Noah rejoiced with them" | Removes causative |

**SOPHIA:** Adopted LOGOS/EMET. The Ge'ez is causative — Noah causes/facilitates their joy as presiding patriarch. PNEUMA's intransitive "rejoiced with them" loses this.

---

**Total disagreements: 5 (minor stylistic)**
